prior_validation_outcomes_known: Original tuning128, refinement512 and duration-audit256 results are already known. These are development experiments, not a new blind test.
analytical_difference: Choose a free-state pause envelope from the sum of two consecutive recorded durations: occupied B followed by an eligible free episode D >= tau. If occupied pauses <= tau and free pauses <= G, every fully missed eligible episode requires B+D<G.
training_data: Same 256 C3 train_development BayIds, Jan-Jun, primary windows >=7 days only; no validation outcomes used to choose G
free_cap_rule: G = min(120, minimum B+D over all complete adjacent occupied/free pairs with D>=60 and an earlier free interval in the window). If no eligible pair, conservative fallback G=60.
policy_template: Freeze the existing C3 without_time lookup; replace only its long-free-run plateau of 75 seconds by G. Free startup stays 30/45 seconds; occupied lookup stays 30/60 seconds. No new coordinate search, hyperparameter grid or best-G selection on validation.
controls: previously selected simple backoff where its saved results are available
evaluation: Previously used development tuning128 and check cohorts256/512, same10 initial phases, primary>=7days plus sensitivity>=1day; all results reported even if worse
additional_certificate: Count risky adjacent pairs independently of the 10 replay phases. Zero on a complete recorded window certifies no missed >=60s free episode for every admissible sampling phase within that window; positive count is an upper bound, not a predicted miss count.
success_rule: Retain as a candidate only if C4 reduces calls versus fixed60, passes original F/O/M60 conditions on both check cohorts and window criteria, and gives a strictly smaller trace risk bound than plateau75. This is not evidence of global novelty or a guarantee for unseen physical trajectories.
